title: say in the reviewer brief which packages fail only from sandbox socket limits, so the reviewer can skip go test ./... and rely on ork's run without guessing

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
Socket-bound tests fail inside a role's sandbox with `setsockopt` and `connect` "operation not permitted". The implementer brief already says this (adj 519, `internal/engine/brief.go:399`). The reviewer and gate briefs say nothing, so a reviewer who runs `go test ./...` sees hundreds of failures in packages the diff does not touch. In ork run ork-20261125-222937-c7ce, item S596, the implementer reported 326 such failures. The reviewer then had to guess whether they were real.

The owner decided on 2026-11-27 (note on S606; Jon chose "Generic line", session 8d711f67) that this needs one generic line in the reviewer and gate briefs, like the implementer line. The line says socket-bound failures in the sandbox are sandbox-limited, ork's round check is the evidence, and the reviewer need not run `go test ./...`. It names no packages.

Owner decision, 2026-11-27 (adj 616): one generic line in the reviewer and gate briefs, naming no packages.

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- `internal/engine/brief.go:440-451` (reviewer and gate checklist branch)
- `internal/engine/brief_test.go:97-136` (implementer and new reviewer/gate sandbox reporting tests); TestClaudeAndCodexReadOnlyDoneWhen also updates its exact checklist expectations
- `docs/design.md:2706-2711` (sandbox evidence guidance)
- `landed-changed/S606.md` (new)

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
- TestReviewerAndGateBriefsNoteSandboxSocketTests (`internal/engine/brief_test.go:114`): for RoleReviewer and RoleGate with ReadOnly = true, BuildBrief produces exactly one new sandbox line in Done when. Assert on the generated line that it contains neither internal/ nor ./internal. Red before the add call in the reviewer/gate branch at `internal/engine/brief.go:440`.
- TestImplementerBriefNotesSandboxSocketTests (`internal/engine/brief_test.go:97`): unchanged; stays green and proves the implementer line is untouched.
- TestReviewerAndGateDoneWhen (`internal/engine/brief_test.go:2172`): unchanged; stays green and keeps existing checklist wording. TestEveryRoleBriefHasADoneWhenSection (`internal/engine/brief_test.go:1570`) enforces the checklist line limit.
- TestClaudeAndCodexReadOnlyDoneWhen (`internal/engine/brief_test.go`): update the exact reviewer and gate checklist expectations for the new guidance; other roles stay unchanged. Reproduced red in fix round 1 before updating expectations.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. In `internal/engine/brief.go`, in the `case RoleReviewer, RoleGate:` branch (line 440), add one `add(...)` call before the `if in.Role == RoleReviewer` split. Both roles get it, and it is a plain string. Proposed text: `Socket-bound tests may fail in sandbox; report them as sandbox-limited, not as findings. ork's round check is the evidence; you need not run go test ./....` The text names no package.
2. In `internal/engine/brief_test.go`, add `TestReviewerAndGateBriefsNoteSandboxSocketTests` beside `TestImplementerBriefNotesSandboxSocketTests`. It loops over RoleReviewer and RoleGate with `ReadOnly = true`, builds the brief with `BuildBrief`, and asserts that `strings.Count` of the line is 1. It also asserts the line contains neither `internal/` nor `./internal`. Run it red before step 1, then green after. Mutation-check it by changing the line text and by removing the `add` call, and see the test fail each time.
3. In `docs/design.md`, extend the sentence at lines 2706-2708. After the implementer sentence, add one that says reviewer and gate briefs carry the same generic line: socket-bound failures are sandbox-limited, ork's round check is the evidence, the role need not run `go test ./...`, and no package is named (S606).
4. Run `slicer changelog add S606 --root /home/jon/code/squalor-xyz/ork --text "Reviewer and gate briefs say socket-bound test failures in the sandbox are sandbox-limited and ork's round check is the evidence, so the reviewer need not run go test ./...."`. This writes `landed-changed/S606.md`. Do not edit `CHANGELOG.md`.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
- `go test -run TestReviewerAndGateBriefsNoteSandboxSocketTests ./internal/engine` passes, and fails before the brief.go change.
- `go test -run TestImplementerBriefNotesSandboxSocketTests ./internal/engine` passes.
- `go test -run TestReviewerAndGateDoneWhen ./internal/engine` passes.
- `go test -run TestEveryRoleBriefHasADoneWhenSection ./internal/engine` passes, so the checklist is still under 40 lines.
- `go test -run TestCloudImplementerByteBaseline ./internal/engine` passes. The implementer brief bytes are unchanged.
- `go vet ./...` prints nothing.
- `gofmt -l .` prints nothing.
- `slicer check` exits 0.
- ork runs the full go test ./... outside the sandbox. Socket-bound failures inside the implementer's sandbox are sandbox-limited.
